proposal.hypothesis: A 2D one-element-per-thread grid avoids integer div/mod to recover the column, keeps x accesses coalesced and parameter accesses cached, minimizing indexing overhead for the 64x257 shape.

Processing four contiguous columns per thread in a 65x64 grid increases independent tanh ILP and amortizes indexing over four elements, reducing scheduling overhead for the small 64x257 tensor versus one element per thread.
